influences.name: Drake
influences.context: I think it's "Own It" because it might not be his objectively best song, but it's the one I always go back to for some reason, and I've cried to a few times, and I don't even know why I'm crying, it just feels so beautiful. It's so soothing to listen to it.

influences.name: Lana Del Rey
influences.context: I feel this way about Lana del Rey too, where I'm very attracted to her music and her message and her brand

influences.name: Peter Denenberg
influences.context: He really helped me out, mostly outside of college. I recorded my next upcoming record at his studio. He's let me stay over at his studio when I didn't have a place to sleep, and he's been a really good guiding figure outside of college.
